events.summary: Owed on the 25% China-origin duty from 1 November is 1,432,968.87 USD (1.43M) across the whole item. The eleven parts' net owed figures are: HR-50110 501,185.64; HR-50210 480,373.20; HR-40110 183,186.97; HR-40210 93,567.53; HR-41110 62,101.04; HR-40120 43,961.34; HR-40310 25,168.27; HR-51120 23,550.45; HR-41120 15,908.65; HR-51320 3,965.78; HR-51220 0. Conditional, owed only if open orders ship after 1 November, is 104,142.43 USD; gross (every open line and the full 12-month forecast, the ceiling) is 2,138,539.04 USD. Of the owed figure, 85,350.35 USD is Yunzhan's seven open orders under force majeure, which cannot ship before 1 November, so that part is owed on certainty of timing, not on a ship date.
